subject: POC success blueprint and milestone cadence
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@cortec.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: POC success blueprint & proposed milestone calendar

Hi Elena — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared plan to kick off the POC next week. I copied the technical and delivery owners from our side for clarity.

Key outcomes from the call
- Top priority: validate inference latency under Cortec’s 256-token average payload and ensure <200ms p95 for the baseline prompt.
- Success criteria (draft for your review): 1) p95 latency <= 200ms on test dataset, 2) stable throughput supporting 100 reqs/min during steady-state, 3) output quality match >= 0.88 F1 on labeled eval set, 4) integration work completed for your API proxy.

Proposed evaluation plan and milestones
1) Week 0 (prep, 3 business days): data access + sample set, network checklist, and baseline benchmark script.
2) Week 1 (kickoff + sandbox runs): initial integration, run baseline, capture latency/throughput.
3) Week 2 (optimization sprint): batching/kv-cache config, quantization pass recommendations.
4) Week 3 (stability & readout): final performance run, quality readout, and decision meeting.

Ownership (R = Redwood, C = Cortec)
- Data & sample sets: Cortec (Elena)
- Network/VPN & access: Cortec IT (it-support@cortec.com)
- Infra and tuning: Marcus Lin (R)
- Eval scripts & metrics: Monica Patel (R)
- Executive readout: Jonas Weber (R)

Immediate asks for next steps
- Elena: confirm which dataset (a 1k-sample subset or full 10k) we should run for the baseline and share S3/GCS access by EOD Wed.
- Cortec IT: confirm whether outbound HTTPS to our sandbox endpoint is allowed (see data checklist).
- Redwood: we’ll schedule a 60-minute kickoff; proposed slots below.

Kickoff options (please pick one)
- Tue Aug 10, 11:00–12:00 PT
- Wed Aug 11, 09:00–10:00 PT
- Thu Aug 12, 14:00–15:00 PT

I attached a draft "POC-Success-Blueprint-v1.pdf" and a working mutual action plan (DOCX) that lists milestones and acceptance gates. I’ll update both based on your feedback.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: POC-Success-Blueprint-v1.pdf, mutual-action-plan.docx

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@cortec.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Cortec Technical <it-support@cortec.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC success blueprint & proposed milestone calendar

Lauren — thanks for the clear recap and the docs. This aligns with what we discussed. A few quick confirmations and a follow-up from IT below.

- Success criteria look good; internally we want to add a security check that no input payloads are logged unencrypted in transit — our compliance team will validate that during Week 0.
- For the baseline run, please use the 1k-sample subset first; we’ll unlock the full 10k if the baseline is stable.
- Kickoff: Tue Aug 10, 11:00–12:00 PT works for our team — confirmed.

IT note (from our side): outbound HTTPS to the sandbox endpoint is allowed but we need a static IP range or a short-lived token scheme. I’ll have our SRE send connection details and a list of required ports by EOD Tuesday.

Also attached the initial data checklist (Cortec-Data-Checklist.xlsx) with redacted S3 paths; we’ll push full access once the NDA window closes.

Looking forward to Tuesday.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Product — Cortec Systems
elena.morales@cortec.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC success blueprint & proposed milestone calendar

Team — quick ops note after reviewing Elena's checklist.

- I’ll provision a dedicated sandbox with the same GPU profile we plan to run in Dedicated mode (A10G-equivalent) and pre-seed the benchmark harness. ETA: end of day Tue.
- Monica, can you confirm the eval script accepts a CSV payload with the label column named "gold_label"? I’ll wire up the metric outputs to a shared run log.
- Jonas, we should flag any SLA asks in the MAP before the kickoff (latency SLOs and throughput requirements) — I’ll draft a short paragraph for the MAP.

Related links: HubSpot deal (see: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/98765) — I created the checklist task under the playbook.

I’ll attach the initial blueprint when I upload the harness (POC-Success-Blueprint-v1.pdf).

-Marcus

Infrastructure Lead, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@cortec.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Cortec Technical <it-support@cortec.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC success blueprint & proposed milestone calendar — Kickoff confirmed (Tue 11/10)

Elena — great, thanks. Confirming kickoff: Tue Aug 10, 11:00–12:00 PT. Below is the 60-minute agenda so attendees know what to prepare.

Agenda (60 min)
- 0–10m: Introductions & objectives (Lauren + Elena)
- 10–25m: Data access and network checklist (Cortec IT + Marcus)
- 25–40m: Benchmark harness overview & success metrics (Monica)
- 40–50m: Tuning levers and quick wins (Marcus)
- 50–60m: Next steps, weekly cadence, and readout scheduling (Jonas)

Weekly cadence: 30-minute syncs every Thu 09:00 PT for the duration of the POC (standing invite to be sent after kickoff).

Action items I’ll take after this thread:
- Send calendar invite for Tue Aug 10 kickoff (11:00–12:00 PT) and a recurring Thu 09:00 PT sync.
- Update MAP with Elena’s token/IP note and Marcus’s SLA paragraph; circulate before kickoff.
- Attach final mutual-action-plan.docx to the invite.

Elena — please pass along the S3 access and SRE contact once available so Marcus can validate connectivity.

Onward — excited to run this.

—
Lauren

Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
